input: Find a local martial arts dojo for adults

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Martial arts styles vary enormously (BJJ, Muay Thai, Karate, Judo, etc.) — knowing a preferred style or goal (self-defense, fitness, competition) narrows the search dramatically.
The user's city or neighborhood is essential for finding geographically relevant dojos — without a location, no meaningful search can be done.
Class schedule availability (evenings, weekends, mornings) determines which dojos are actually practical for the user to attend.
Monthly membership fees at martial arts schools vary widely ($50–$300+); knowing a budget ceiling filters out unsuitable options.
Whether this is for a complete beginner or someone with prior experience affects which programs and school types are most appropriate.
Some users prioritize a sport/competition environment, others want a casual fitness-focused class or a traditional/cultural school — this shapes which dojo culture fits best.
Understanding what 'done well' looks like — e.g., booking a trial class, visiting 3 shortlisted dojos, or simply getting a curated list — defines when the task is complete.

gold.taskTitle: Find a local adult martial arts dojo
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to locate a suitable martial arts school in their area that offers classes for adults.

questions.title: Which martial arts style are you interested in?
questions.description: Identify the specific style or discipline the user wants to train in (e.g., BJJ, Muay Thai, Karate, Judo, MMA, Taekwondo) or whether they are open to any style.

questions.title: What city or neighborhood are you searching in?
questions.description: Establish the user's location so the search can be geographically targeted and relevant.

questions.title: Which days and times can you realistically attend classes?
questions.description: Determine the user's weekly schedule availability to filter out dojos whose timetables don't fit.

questions.title: What is your monthly budget for membership fees?
questions.description: Identify a budget range so only financially viable schools are recommended.

questions.title: Are you a complete beginner or do you have prior training?
questions.description: Gauge the user's experience level to match them with beginner-friendly programs or more advanced training environments.

questions.title: Is your priority fitness, self-defense, or competitive sport?
questions.description: Understand the user's primary goal to match them with the right dojo culture and program focus.

questions.title: What would completing this task look like for you?
questions.description: Clarify the desired outcome — a shortlist of options, a booked trial class, or a visited dojo — so the task has a clear finish line.
